plugin.name: Program book
plugin.description: Write a plugin as a book: manifest, code pages (explanation, then code), language pages, tests and a build page; tests run in an empty sandbox; try it out, build a signed package.
field.out.placeholder: Empty: the first folder granted to program books
page.alone: Put this page in a book: the book's manifest, code and language pages make up the plugin.
check.ok: No problems: these files make a valid plugin.
manifest.badJson: The manifest is not valid JSON: {message}
problem.noManifestPage: The book has no manifest page yet.
problem.badPath: bad file name (a relative path of letters, digits, . _ -)
problem.samePath: the same file as another page
problem.twoManifests: a book has one manifest page
problem.mainMissing: the main file is not in the book
problem.localeMissing: the language file is not in the book
problem.badLocale: a language file holds only key → text
problem.missingKey: other languages have this key, this one has not
problem.tooLarge: too many or too large files
code.noPath: Name the file this page is (e.g. main.js).
code.badPath: The file name must be a relative path ending in .js, of letters, digits, . _ -.
code.samePath: Another page in the book is {path} too.
locale.missing: Keys other languages have and this one has not: {keys}
locale.complete: {n} texts, as complete as the other languages.
test.how: How: test("name", () => { expect(actual).toBe(expected); }); load("lib/x.js") gives a file of the book; fakeHost({ resources: [...] }) is a host that lives in memory only. Tests run in an empty sandbox and reach nothing real.
build.head: **{id}** {version} · {files} files
build.noFolder: No folder to write to: grant program books a folder, or write one in “Output folder”.
build.install.expired: Not installed: the confirmation timed out.
build.sameVersion: Version {version} is built already: change the version in the manifest first.
build.noIdentity: Building signs with the workspace's identity: create one in “Identity” first.
conv.language: JavaScript only; files import each other as "./path" (from the package root).
conv.files: The manifest, code and language pages make up the plugin's files; test pages are not in the package.
conv.tests: Tests run in an empty sandbox: only test, expect, load and fakeHost.
ai.tool.test: Run all tests of a program book (in an empty sandbox, read-only) and return each test's result.
ai.notAProgram: This book has no manifest page; it is not a program book.
